major_events: Yan Chenyu accuses Yanshui Tian of conspiring with Fang Han during her promotion ceremony, while Yanshui Tian exposes Yan Chenyu's alliance with Su Xiuyi (第706章 慢着).
A Celestial Messenger descends to the Eternal Temple of the Taiyi Sect to supervise and direct the upcoming conflict against the God Race (第708章 仙界使者).
Fang Han travels to the Cultivation Great World with Jiuding Xianzun to source raw materials for refining the Eight Parts Pagoda (第709章 修真大世界).
Fang Han discovers a shard of a Weapon of Creation at the Jiuding Xuan trading venue and acquires it (第711章 古怪碎片, 第712章 白羲).
Fang Han bids 200 billion pure yang pills for the Tianwei Horn at the Fenbao Rock auction, outbidding and infuriating Gongyang Laoren (第715章 天威号角, 第716章 开始炼制).

Jiuding Xianzun and Bai Xi attempt to betray Fang Han during the refining process, but Fang Han sacrifices lifespan using a specialized pill to reclaim the Eight Parts Pagoda and break through to the Heavenly Position Realm (第719章 图穷匕见, 第724章 斩杀).
Fang Han subdues Bai Xi, using the Great Puppet and Great Purifying techniques to refine the divine beast into the Cangsheng Seal as its new vessel spirit (第726章 荒神之匙第四层).
The Celestial Messenger and the Eternal Divine Furnace negotiate Yanshui Tian's fate, sealing and sending her to the Immortal Realm to draw out Fang Han (第745章 永恒天君).
Hua Tiandu kneels to the Celestial Messenger, becomes his disciple, and is sent to the Immortal Realm to cultivate and plot against Fang Han (第745章 永恒天君).
Fang Han rescues Mibao from Dazhai Shenzun's ambush, sacrificing 4 billion Heavenly Devils via the Holy Sacrifice technique to survive the clash (第775章 撼世三招, 第777章 惊世撞击).
Mibao heals Fang Han's shattered body via dual cultivation, triggering his breakthrough to the Boundary King Realm (第778章 修成界王, 第779章 山门异变).
Fang Han returns to Yuhua Sect, suppresses Meng Shaobai's usurpation attempt, and defeats his backers Zhou Tian Xianzun and Xuan Wugu (第781章 老东西, 第782章 怒了).
Fang Han defeats and captures Qi Zhenjun, refining the Void Immortal into a slave in the Eight Parts Pagoda (第836章 和光同尘大仙阵).
Fang Han merges the Yuhua and Qunxing Sects to establish the Zaohua Gate, acting as the sect leader and moving secular empires into the Cangsheng Seal (第824章 两派合并, 第825章 造化门).
Fang Han melts the Celestial Messenger's avatar, enabling him to break through to the Hundong Realm and open the 6th layer of the Huang Shen Zhi Shi (第809章 混洞秘境, 第826章 荒神之匙第六层).
Fang Han travels to the Dragon's Grave, refines the Eight Parts Pagoda into an Ultimate-grade Dao weapon, and successfully crosses the Void Immortal lightning tribulation (第867章 命星雷, 第869章 彻底蜕变).
Fang Han fights the dragon emperors in the Dragon's Grave, repelling Xing Gange and Long Di (第874章 斩龙（下）, 第875章 宝主身亡).
Fang Han battles Juewushen, utilizing the Small Destiny Technique and burning Chaos Flesh to comprehend life and death, achieving the True Immortal realm (第890章 杀死绝武神).
Fang Han and Linglong Xianzun raid Taiyuan Xianfu to secure the Gate of Xuanpin, fighting off various world alliances (第911章 再入太元仙府, 第923章 玄牝出世).
Fang Han kills and refines the God Immortal Jixiang Changkong Buddha into the Zhou Tian Yi, upgrading the treasure to a Celestial Artifact (第931章 打成肉饼, 第932章 周天仪变化仙器).
Fang Han achieves the Celestial realm, overcoming the gold immortal's attack at the化仙池 with the protection of the Chaos Heavenly King's shadow (第930章 晋升天仙, 第931章 打成肉饼).
character_state_transitions: Fang Han: From Longevity Realm 5th layer to 6th layer (Heavenly Position Realm) after merging with the Primordial Ancestral Dragon's aura on Panlong Star (第724章 斩杀).
Fang Han: From Heavenly Position Realm to 7th layer (Boundary King Realm) after dual-cultivating with Mibao, which heals his body and matures his world seed (第779章 山门异变).
Fang Han: From Boundary King Realm to 8th layer (Hundong Realm) by melting the energy avatar of the Celestial Messenger (第809章 混洞秘境).
Fang Han: From Hundong Realm to 9th layer (Void Immortal) after braving the lightning tribulation and the shadows of three王品仙器 in the Dragon's Grave (第869章 彻底蜕变).
Fang Han: From Void Immortal to 10th layer (True Immortal) by burning Chaos Flesh and utilizing the Small Destiny Technique during the duel with Juewushen (第890章 杀死绝武神).
Fang Han: From True Immortal to Celestial (天仙) by detonating and absorbing the Chaos Flesh Womb during the invasion of the God Race (第930章 晋升天仙).
Yanshui Tian: From the designated heir of Taiyi Sect to a captured traitor exposed as Fang Han's lover, sent to the Immortal Realm as a hostage (第706章 慢着, 第745章 永恒天君).
Mibao: From the first lady of Fenbao Rock to Fang Han's dual-cultivation wife and strategic partner, cultivating Origin Fist (第713章 分宝岩, 第778章 修成界王, 第917章 激战).
Bai Xi: From a scheming, arrogant director of Fenbao Rock to a captured and purified vessel spirit serving inside the Cangsheng Seal (第712章 白羲, 第726章 荒神之匙第四层).
Hua Tiandu: From a defeated and destitute former genius of Yuhua Sect to the disciple of the Celestial Messenger, ascending to the Immortal Realm to seek revenge (第745章 永恒天君).
Xuan Wugu: From a plotting Void Immortal of Saint Light Empire to a purified slave and protector inside Fang Han's Eight Parts Pagoda (第780章 周天仙尊, 第783章 荒神之匙第五层).
Wind Baiyu: From Yuhua Sect Leader to an elder of Zaohua Gate, eventually breaking through to the Celestial realm alongside Fang Han (第825章 造化门, 第932章 周天仪变化仙器).
long_form_mechanisms: Eight Parts Pagoda Refinement: A supreme dragon artifact requiring rare materials like苍龙之角 and龙帝之血. Refinement in the Dragon's Grave accelerates its growth, summoning the Primordial Ancestral Dragon spirit to grant the user immense physical strength and lifespan (第713章, 第716章).

Small Destiny Technique: A fragment of the Great Destiny Technique that burns the caster's lifespan to generate temporary power, comprehend higher laws, or forcefully refine stubborn artifacts (第722章, 第776章, 第890章).

Yuanshi Zhi Qi and Yuanshi Tianqiu: A supreme energy stored inside the 6th layer of the Huang Shen Zhi Shi within the Yuanshi Tianqiu. It requires a set cycle of time to produce a thread of Yuanshi Zhi Qi, which contains energy exceeding 1 trillion pure yang pills, capable of powering top Dao weapons and enabling True Immortals to break through to Celestials (第826章).

Holy Sacrifice Grand Immortal Art: A forbidden method that sacrifices living entities (such as billions of Heavenly Devils) within a magic weapon to trigger a brief, massive amplification of combat power, bypassing normal realm suppression (第776章).

Dual Cultivation Yin-Yang Transfer: A mechanism where Mibao transfers her Yin Essence and cultivation to Fang Han's body, which repairs fatal injuries and facilitates the rapid evolution of his world seed (第778章).

Ascension and 化仙池 Tribulation: The process where a cultivator's soul ascends to the Immortal Realm's 化仙池 to form Celestial laws. Hostile Golden Immortals can attack the soul at this pool to prevent ascension, requiring external protection or ancient seals to succeed (第930章).

33-Heaven Creation Flow: The mechanism where upgrading the 33-Heaven Treasures triggers a downpour of Creation energy, allowing all living beings and followers inside the user's world to experience breakthroughs simultaneously (第915章, 第930章).

Origin Fist and Origin Laws: A supreme martial art originating from the Origin Heavenly King, embodying the weight of beginnings to crush space and physical opponents, utilized by Mibao and Fang Han (第917章).
continuity_observations: The World Tree shard purchased in early volumes serves as the key foundation for Fang Han's cultivation, continuing here as it enables him to absorb liquid immortal energy from the Gate of the Immortal World (第809章).
Yanshui Tian's relationship with Fang Han, established in earlier arcs, reaches its climax when Yan Chenyu exposes her, leading to her capture and flight to the Immortal Realm (第706章, 第745章).
Mibao's introduction as a powerful merchant lead at Fenbao Rock consistently develops into her saving Fang Han and eventually double-cultivating with him (第713章, 第778章).
Meng Shaobai's long-standing rivalry with Fang Han continues when he attempts to seize Yuhua Sect, only to be effortlessly suppressed when Fang Han returns (第780章, 第781章).
The sequential opening of the Huang Shen Zhi Shi layers matches Fang Han's breakthroughs, progressing from the 4th layer in Chapter 726 to the 7th layer in Chapter 913/917.
Hua Tiandu's inability to defeat Fang Han on earth culminates in him choosing to fly to the Immortal Realm to seek higher power, keeping his rivalry alive (第745章).
The foreshadowed God Race invasion breaks out, drawing in multiple external worlds (Saint Light, Wanyaoxinghe) and driving the main conflicts of the latter half of the chunk (第812章, 第822章, 第929章).
Taiyuan Xianfu, introduced in the beginning of the novel, is revisited in this chunk as the location containing the Gate of Xuanpin, resolving a long-standing mystery (第908章, 第911章).
The Cangsheng Seal, originally a treasure of Wuji Great World, continues its role as a container, housing secular dynasties moved by Fang Han (第726章, 第825章).
style_observations: Numerical Hyperbole: The text uses massive mathematical figures to represent wealth and power, such as bidding 200 billion pills (第716章) or consuming 3 trillion pills in an instant (第719章).
Calculated Betrayal ('各怀鬼胎'): Alignments are shown as purely transactional and temporary, with characters constantly plotting to double-cross their partners (第717章, 第718章).
Visceral Carnage ('打成肉饼'): Clashes are described with brutal, physical details, where enemies are frequently turned into meat pies or dry corpses (第725章, 第931章).
Sarcastic and Defiant Protagonist: Fang Han routinely mocks senior experts, calling them old things ('老东西') and dismissing their status (第781章).
Symbolic Moves: Grandiose names are given to attacks and repeated to emphasize their power, such as Dazhai's '撼世三招' (第775章) and Hongmeng's '天元一击' (第928章).
Pragmatic Dual Cultivation: Romantic encounters are stripped of emotional build-up and depicted as highly efficient, business-like energy transfers (第778章).
Hostile Celestial Bureaucracy: The Immortal Realm is depicted as a cruel, highly hierarchical space where ascendants are treated as slaves or dogs (第745章, 第930章).

三千大道 (Three Thousand Great Daos)
creation_family_evidence.stylistic_signature: Highly aggressive protagonist who kills and loots systematically, rapid realm level-ups, massive numerical scales for lifespans and pill consumption, and transactional relationships.
creation_family_evidence.compilation_indicators: The chapter headers utilize uniform Chinese numbering format followed by a space and the title (e.g., '第706章 慢着', '第716章 开始炼制') and double-byte spacing at paragraph starts, indicating standard web serialization compilation formatting.

systematic_looting_and_supremacy.details: The protagonist's central drive is acquiring resources (pure yang pills, Dao weapons, immortal bodies) to fuel immediate cultivation breakthroughs, depicting a highly transactional view of cultivation where power is directly bought or looted.

originality_risks: Formulaic Looting and Breakthrough Loop: The progression where Fang Han goes to a trade area, is insulted by a senior, outbids them, is ambushed, defeats the attackers, steals their assets, and uses them to level up is highly formulaic (第709-726章).

Convenient Dual Cultivation: The use of double-cultivation with Mibao to immediately heal fatal physical damage and achieve a breakthrough to the Boundary King Realm acts as a convenient plot shortcut (第778-779章).

Repetitive Usurper Plot: The plotline where a rival (Meng Shaobai) attempts to usurp the sect while the protagonist is away, only to be easily defeated upon his return, is a common and repetitive genre trope (第780-783章).

Young Master and Father Revenge Loop: The cycle where an arrogant young master is captured/killed, prompting their powerful father to seek revenge, only to be also captured and refined by the protagonist, drives the Cultivation Great World conflicts repetitively (第738-743章).

Holy Sacrifice Power-up: The mechanism where the protagonist can sacrifice billions of lower-level entities to temporarily bypass multiple realms of cultivation differences diminishes the stakes of normal cultivation progression (第776章).
